title: Approvals
description: Whether your Bots ask before they change things, and rules that apply to all of them.

askBeforeChanges.title: Ask before making changes
askBeforeChanges.description: Review a Bot's changes to websites, connected apps, and files.

autoReview.title: Auto-review
autoReview.description: Before an action that could affect your accounts or share information, a model checks it against what you asked for, your rules and the safety requirements. If it cannot decide, it asks you.

hostCommands.title: Commands on your computer
hostCommands.description: The OpenBot desktop app still shows each command before it runs on your computer.

rules.title: Rules
rules.botDescription: The strictest matching rule wins, so an "ask" rule beats an "allow" one. Rules for every Bot are in <link>Settings → Approvals</link>.
rules.offNote: Your team has switched personal rules off, so they are kept but do not apply.
rules.otherBotsDescription: These name no Bot you can open, but they still apply to any Bot they match. Remove the ones you no longer want.
rules.descriptionPrefix: Rules for a single Bot are on

form.rowDescription: A tool or app, and what a Bot does before using it.
form.wildcardHint: * matches anything, so mcp/gmail/* is every Gmail tool and a target of *.example.com is every page on that site.
form.targetHint: *, a site, a folder, a Bot name

teamSettings.title: Team settings

hostCommandsCap.title: Commands on members' computers, at most
hostCommandsCap.description: A member's own stricter setting still applies.

teamSettings.rulesDescription: These apply to every member's Bots, and members cannot change them.

why.refusedCall: A call was refused because this Bot reaches more people than approved.
why.publish: Its owner widened who can reach it.
why.trigger: Its owner added a trigger that lets outside input steer it.
why.grant: It was granted the app's actions.
